(function(){var out=[];function scan(s,si){var t=[].slice.call(s.querySelectorAll('text'));var b=t.map(function(x){var r=null;try{r=x.getBBox();}catch(e){}return r&&r.width>1?r:null;});for(var i=0;i<t.length;i++){if(!b[i])continue;for(var j=i+1;j<t.length;j++){if(!b[j])continue;var ox=Math.min(b[i].x+b[i].width,b[j].x+b[j].width)-Math.max(b[i].x,b[j].x);var oy=Math.min(b[i].y+b[i].height,b[j].y+b[j].height)-Math.max(b[i].y,b[j].y);if(ox>2&&oy>2)out.push(si+': '+t[i].textContent.slice(0,8)+' × '+t[j].textContent.slice(0,8));}}}[].forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('svg'),scan);return out.length?out.slice(0,12).join(' ; '):'no text overlap';})()
